description.0: A hefty tome containing the Royal Energy Commission's internal rules and procedures, with numerous entries dating back many years.

0.0: Increases CRIT DMG by <cryo>24%</cryo>. The equipping character gains the Crystal Compounding effect when they use their Elemental Skill, increasing Elemental Mastery by <cryo>48</cryo> for 20s. During this time, the equipping character gains a Law of Combustion stack when a nearby party member triggers an Elemental Reaction. Each stack increases Elemental Mastery by an additional <cryo>24</cryo>. Max 3 stacks. These stacks last until Crystal Compounding ends or the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill again.
0.1: Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Each Law of Combustion stack also increases the equipping character's Stellar-Conduct CRIT DMG by <cryo>12%</cryo>.
0.2: These effects can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
